question: Who transmigrates below pradhana, and who never goes below Maya?
premises: therefore by Samkhya view the established below pradhana would not transmigrate
inference: Samkhya stops below pradhana; kala-purusha discrimination never sinks below Maya.
plain_english: Therefore by Samkhya view the established below pradhana would not transmigrate — in kala-purusha discrimination below Maya never goes.
